name: blux-ui-build
description: Builds the generated assets of Blux.UI. Only needed to work on the library, never by apps using it.

scripts.css: tailwindcss -i src/Blux.UI/styles/blux.css -o src/Blux.UI/wwwroot/blux.css --minify && tailwindcss -i src/Blux.UI/styles/blux.preflight.css -o src/Blux.UI/wwwroot/blux.preflight.css --minify
scripts.build: npm run classes && npm run css && npm run js && npm run site:css
